title: Responsible Gaming
subtitle: Tools and resources to help you stay in control and enjoy betting as a safe form of entertainment.
intro: At Cricbet99, we want every player to have a positive experience. Gaming should be fun, social, and strictly managed as a form of entertainment—never as a way to make money.
We provide all our members with the tools they need to manage their participation, including deposit limits, session timers, and easy self-exclusion options.
If betting ever stops being fun or starts affecting your daily life, we are here to support you. Our human-led support team is trained to assist players who need help regaining control.

features.title: Custom Deposit Limits
features.desc: Set daily, weekly, or monthly caps on your deposits to ensure you only spend what you can afford.

features.title: Self-Exclusion Tools
features.desc: Request a temporary or permanent break from the platform at any time via WhatsApp support.

features.title: Session Time Alerts
features.desc: Receive notifications to track how long you've been active, helping you maintain a healthy balance.

features.title: Zero Borrowing Policy
features.desc: We actively discourage betting with borrowed funds and offer bankroll management advice.

features.title: Age Verification
features.desc: Strict 18+ protocols ensure that our platform remains a safe environment for adults only.

features.title: Professional Resources
features.desc: Direct links to international gaming support organizations for confidential, expert assistance.
